indicator_name: Share of money income by population decile, quarterly
description: Доля денежных доходов по 10-процентным (децильным) группам населения, поквартально
methodology: Discrete quarters (IV quarter 2024: bottom decile 3.91 against 4.03 for the year). From 2022-Q3 the quarterly editions; 2011-Q1 to 2022-Q2 Taldau 704515, which lacks 2017-Q1 to Q3 and 2021-Q2 (left missing). Where both exist Taldau differs from the editions by 0.01-0.1 on some points; the editions are kept. Taldau 704515 fills the periods no edition covers (before 2022-07-01); on the 122 overlapping points it differs from the editions in 16, e.g. 2022-07-01 D01: 4.36 in Taldau against 4.37 -- the editions are kept. Editions read: 7475 2022Q3, 14911 2022Q4, 65647 2023Q1, 84709 2023Q2, 160961 2023Q3, 160955 2023Q4, 193651 2024Q1, 212356 2024Q2, 265869 2024Q3, 281637 2024Q4, 347021 2025Q1, 348035 2025Q2, 358743 2025Q3, 281638 2025Q4, 347022 2026Q1.
